_comment: Elements that lead to more than one place, each way under its own name and condition.
{ map, element, cell, gfx, type, skill, ways: [ { name, toMap, toCell, criterion } ] }
name is a row of the client's SkillNamesDataRoot: 47 «Ir a Astrub.», 48 «Hacia el territorio
de los dioses». The class temples' statues are all here: the 2.73 world graph carries their
two transitions, type 32 with skill 184, to Astrub's Temple of the Twelve once the temple's
book is read ((Qo>book&PG=class), the devotion's objective) and to the gods' territory with
quest 1938 in hand or done. Landing: Astrub on cell 483, where Incarnam's portal lands; the
territory on the walkable cell nearest the graph's 449, which is not walkable.
Type 128 is what a capture declares the steamers' statue (gfx 62135) with.
A way may carry a skill of its own instead of a name: the abyssal base's lifts offer each floor
as a skill the client names, 212 «Ir a Sufokia», 240 «Hacia las salas de las salpicaduras», 241
«Hacia las salas de las corrientes», 242 «Hacia las salas de los abismos», 243 «Hacia el Acuadomo
de Merkator» -- the 2.73 graph's type-32 transitions from each lift, with those skills. The
Undertow Rooms open with «Torcer el brazo» (1441) done and the Abyss Rooms with «Basta de Bazano»
(1440), the Aquadome's lift with «Profundímetro» (1442) (Dofus pour les noobs, «Chemin vers le
donjon Aquadôme de Merkator»: «À bas Kralab Rah», «KO pour Bosko Tho», «Relevez les niveaux»).
Type 226 is the client's «Ascensor», the name the guide's capture shows over the Aquadome's lift.
